name: Backpack
effect: A sturdy canvas or leather pack with straps for carrying provisions and traveling equipment. Increases the character's Encumbrance Threshold by 4. Adds 2 Setback dice to checks in combat.

name: Bedroll
effect: A compact bundle of bedding tied for easy carriage on the road.

name: Blanket
effect: A heavy woolen covering useful for warmth at camp or on the march.

name: Small Tent
effect: A simple canvas shelter suitable for one or two travelers.

name: Large Tent
effect: A roomy canvas pavilion that shelters a small group and its belongings.

name: Waterskin
effect: A stitched leather vessel for carrying drinking water or other liquids. Encumbrance listed assumes the waterskin is full.

name: Rope
effect: A coil of stout hemp rope useful for hauling, climbing, and securing loads.

name: Grappling Hook
effect: An iron hook with several prongs, made to catch on ledges, walls, or railings.

name: Flint and Steel
effect: A striker and sharp flint used with tinder to kindle a fire.

name: Torches (3)
effect: Pitch-soaked wooden brands that provide a portable but short-lived flame.

name: Lantern
effect: A hooded metal lamp that protects its flame from wind and directs its light.

name: Lamp Oil
effect: A small supply of combustible oil for keeping lamps and lanterns alight.

name: Rations, One Day
effect: Dried meat, hard bread, and other preserved food sufficient for one day of travel.

name: Cooking Kit
effect: A portable assortment of pots, utensils, and implements for preparing meals over a fire.

name: Winter Clothing
effect: Thick wool, fur, and layered garments intended for travel through bitter weather. When worn, removes up to 2 Setback dice from Survival or Resilience checks caused by cold weather.

name: Apothecary Kit
effect: A case of herbs, salves, powders, and small instruments used to prepare remedies.

name: Healer's Kit
effect: Bandages, needles, splints, and basic implements for treating wounds in the field.

name: Thieves' Tools
effect: Fine picks, probes, and tension tools for working delicate locks and mechanisms.

name: Climbing Gear
effect: Ropes, straps, hooks, and other equipment for negotiating steep or sheer surfaces.

name: Hunting & Fishing Kit
effect: Snares, lines, hooks, and dressing tools for gathering food from the wild.

name: Navigation Instruments
effect: A collection of charts, measuring tools, and directional aids for finding a route.

name: Writing Kit
effect: Quills, ink, parchment, and small accessories for correspondence and recordkeeping.

name: Crowbar
effect: A heavy iron lever for prying open doors, crates, and stubborn fittings.

name: Shovel
effect: An iron-bladed digging tool with a sturdy wooden handle.

name: Hammer & Pitons
effect: A small hammer and iron spikes for securing ropes to rock or masonry.

name: Bridle & Basic Tack
effect: A bridle, reins, and simple fittings for leading and controlling a mount.

name: Riding Saddle
effect: A fitted leather seat that makes long journeys on horseback more secure and comfortable.

name: War Saddle
effect: A high-pommeled, reinforced saddle built to keep a rider steady in the violence of combat.

name: Saddlebags
effect: Paired leather bags that hang beside a saddle to carry supplies.

name: Pack Saddle
effect: A wooden or leather-framed rig designed to balance cargo across a beast of burden.

name: Horseshoes
effect: Iron shoes nailed to a horse’s hooves to protect them on hard and stony roads.

name: Lodging (Common Room)
effect: A night's shelter in the shared quarters of an inn or tavern, usually with a place by the hearth and a straw pallet or space on the floor.

name: Lodging (Private Room)
effect: A private chamber at an inn, furnished with a bed, washbasin, and a door that can be closed against unwanted company.

name: Porter (daily)
effect: A hired laborer who carries baggage, hauls supplies, and performs other physically demanding tasks throughout a day's travel.

name: Torchbearer (daily)
effect: A hired attendant who carries a torch or lantern, keeping the way illuminated while their employer's hands remain free.

name: Guide (daily)
effect: A local familiar with the roads, trails, settlements, and hazards of a particular region, hired to lead travelers safely through unfamiliar country.

name: Travel by Riverboat (daily)
effect: Passage aboard a riverboat carrying passengers and cargo along the waterways of the Seven Kingdoms, subject to currents, weather, and the river's course.

name: Travel by Wagon (daily)
effect: Passage aboard a horse- or mule-drawn wagon traveling the roads and tracks of the realm, with limited comfort among its cargo and fellow passengers.

name: Travel by Carriage (daily)
effect: Passage in a covered, horse-drawn carriage offering cushioned seating and shelter from the elements, favored by wealthy travelers and those of noble birth.
